CustomField.label: Salutation
CustomField.description: ★R8 SEIM_PERSON.SALUTE. Free text rather than a picklist: the source lists carry Mr / Ms / Dr / Prof and academic and diplomatic forms this design cannot enumerate in advance, and a restricted picklist would silently drop whatever it has not been told about. The cost is that "Dr" and "Dr." are two values and nothing reconciles them — acceptable for a field that is only ever printed, never filtered on.
